description: List all GTM accounts accessible to the authenticated user. Returns account IDs, names, and share-data flags.

includeGoogleTags.description: Also include results from the Google Tags accounts.

maxPages.description: Maximum number of API pages to fetch (default 50). If more pages remain, the result includes truncated:true and a nextPageToken.

pageToken.description: Continuation token to resume listing from a previous truncated result.

name: accounts_list
